notes: date comparison is tier 1 by opcode (compare); the dates feature tag carries the value-level requirement, per docs/isa.md's tier note
docs/isa.md: a mixed Date/DateTime pair coerces the Date to 00:00:00 UTC before comparing
docs/isa.md: a Date is never strictly equal to a DateTime, since strict equality is Elixir === and the two are different structs - even at the same instant

docs/isa.md: two lists compare element-wise, and two Date members inside them compare chronologically, as the same pair does at the top level - not by the struct's field order, which reads the day before the month and year
docs/isa.md: two DateTime members inside two lists compare chronologically
a Date member pair level by instant steps to the next member, which decides chronologically
a DateTime member pair level by instant steps to the next member, which decides chronologically
